brief:
Rapper Macklemore completed his Free Palestine tour with a sold-out performance in London, Middle East Eye reported. The concert featured appearances by climate activist Greta Thunberg and Palestinian musician Arab Barghouti, among others supporting the tour's messaging.

The tour, which moved through multiple cities, previously included performances in Dublin featuring musicians Hozier and Kneecap. Macklemore used the platform to draw attention to the situation in Gaza, with the artist stating that Palestinian children are "our children."

title: Macklemore concludes Free Palestine tour with sold-out London show
